citations.quote: The Sharpe ratio can be described as the return (or reward) per unit of variability (or risk).
The appraisal ratio, more commonly called the information ratio, is the ratio of alpha to residual risk.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Family card for the Sharpe-form reward/variability template: ratio = excess return over a dispersion measure, read as the gradient on a return-risk plane. The Information Ratio is its benchmark-relative twin (excess over tracking error), with MAD, Gini, and skew/kurtosis-adjusted denominator variants.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Variability Ratios: Sharpe and the Information Ratio
